characters.bin is a synthetic, independently encoded build-12340 SMSG_CHAR_ENUM
payload. It contains two records, not a capture of any user's characters.

Count: 2
1: GUID 9007199254740993, name Arlen, race 1, class 1, gender 0, level 60,
   zone 12, map 0.
2: GUID 99, name Mira, race 11, class 8, gender 1, level 12,
   zone 3524, map 530.

Both records: appearance bytes 2,3,4,5,6; xyz 1.5,-2.5,3.25;
guild 100; flags 0x2000; customization 0x10000; first-login 1;
pet display/level/family 999,20,23. For each of the 23 equipment/bag slots,
display ID = 1000+slot, inventory type = slot, enchantment = 2000+slot.

Encoding: count u8; per record GUID u64 LE, name UTF-8 plus NUL,
9 appearance/identity/level bytes, zone/map u32 LE, xyz float32 LE,
guild/flags/customization u32 LE, first-login u8, three pet u32 LE,
then 23 repetitions of (u32 LE, u8, u32 LE).
